name: WaveUp Tasker Plugin
tagline: Use this simple Tasker plugin to enable/disable WaveUp at will.
blurb: A Tasker plugin to allow to enable and disable WaveUp using Tasker.
description:
A Tasker plugin to allow to enable and disable WaveUp using Tasker. For the nerdier 😉

This Tasker plugin is based on Termux:Task and is also released under the GPLv3 license. Of course, it's also open source and you can check out the code.

@Termux Team: Thank you very much for this cool piece of code!

How to use

★ Create a new Tasker Action.
★ In the resulting Select Action Category dialog, select Plugin.
★ In the resulting Action Plugin dialog, select WaveUp.
★ Edit the configuration to specify whether WaveUp should be enabled or disabled.
